lineages.name: Human
lineages.description: Adaptable and ambitious people found in every land.

traits.name: Ambitious
traits.description: Gain one extra talent of your choice at 1st level (sample text).

lineages.name: Dwarf
lineages.description: Stout folk with deep ties to stone and craft.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: See in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: Advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage (sample text).

lineages.name: Elf
lineages.description: Long-lived people attuned to magic and the wild.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: See in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep; 4 hours of meditation counts as a long rest (sample text).

lineages.name: Orc
lineages.description: Strong, enduring people with a fierce drive.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: See in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light.

traits.name: Relentless
traits.description: Once per long rest, when reduced to 0 HP you drop to 1 HP instead (sample text).

lineages.name: Smallfolk
lineages.description: Small, nimble folk with a knack for slipping out of trouble.

traits.name: Nimble
traits.description: You can move through the space of a creature larger than you (sample text).

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: See in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light.

traits.name: Draconic Resistance
traits.description: Resistance to one damage type tied to your draconic ancestry (sample text).

lineages.name: Beastkin
lineages.description: People who carry the traits of animals.

traits.name: Animal Instincts
traits.description: Choose an animal aspect that grants a movement or sense trait (sample text).

lineages.name: Syderean
lineages.description: People touched by the celestial or fiendish planes.

traits.name: Planar Resistance
traits.description: Resistance to radiant or necrotic damage, based on your origin (sample text).

heritages.name: Cosmopolitan
heritages.description: Raised in a bustling city among many cultures.

traits.name: Street Savvy
traits.description: Proficiency in one Charisma skill of your choice, picked during creation (sample text).

heritages.name: Nomadic
heritages.description: Raised on the move, never long in one place.

traits.name: Traveler
traits.description: Your speed is not reduced by difficult terrain from natural weather (sample text).

heritages.name: Wildlands
heritages.description: Raised far from cities, in the wild places of the world.

traits.name: Wild Lore
traits.description: Proficiency in Survival (sample text).

heritages.name: Fireforge
heritages.description: Raised in a forge-city of smiths and makers.

traits.name: Forge Trained
traits.description: Proficiency with smith's tools (sample text).

heritages.name: Grove
heritages.description: Raised in a forest community close to nature.

traits.name: Grove Magic
traits.description: You know one primordial cantrip (sample text).

traits.name: Monster Lore
traits.description: Advantage on checks to recall information about monsters (sample text).

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.description: You served in an army or militia.
backgrounds.equipment: Insignia of rank, Gaming set, Common clothes, Pouch

traits.name: Military Rank
traits.description: Soldiers loyal to your former organization recognize your authority (sample text).

backgrounds.name: Scholar
backgrounds.description: You spent years studying in libraries and academies.
backgrounds.equipment: Ink and quill, Book of lore, Common clothes, Pouch

traits.name: Researcher
traits.description: You know where to find information you don't have (sample text).

backgrounds.name: Criminal
backgrounds.equipment: Crowbar, Dark clothes with hood, Pouch

traits.name: Criminal Contact
traits.description: You have a reliable contact in the criminal underworld (sample text).

backgrounds.name: Adherent
backgrounds.description: You served a temple or faith.
backgrounds.equipment: Holy symbol, Prayer book, Vestments, Pouch

traits.name: Shelter of the Faithful
traits.description: Temples of your faith offer you aid and lodging (sample text).

backgrounds.name: Homesteader
backgrounds.description: You worked the land in a rural community.
backgrounds.equipment: Shovel, Iron pot, Common clothes, Pouch

traits.name: Rustic Hospitality
traits.description: Common folk will shelter and hide you (sample text).

backgrounds.name: Artist
backgrounds.description: You made your living through performance or craft.

traits.name: By Popular Demand
traits.description: You can always find a place to perform for room and board (sample text).

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: A master of weapons and armor (sample class data).

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Adopt a fighting style that grants a combat benefit (sample text).

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: Bonus action: regain 1d10 + fighter level HP.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: Take one additional action on your turn.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: Reroll a failed saving throw.

features.name: Extra Attack (2)
features.description: Attack three times when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Extra Attack (3)
features.description: Attack four times when you take the Attack action.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: A skilled expert in stealth and precision (sample class data).
classes.otherProficiencies: Hand crossbows, longswords, rapiers, shortswords; thieves' tools

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Double your proficiency bonus for two chosen skills (sample text).

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn deal extra damage (1d6 at 1st level) with a finesse or ranged weapon when you have advantage.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

features.name: Sneak Attack 2d6
features.description: Sneak Attack damage increases.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: Reaction: halve the damage of an attack that hits you.

features.name: Sneak Attack 3d6
features.description: Sneak Attack damage increases.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: Take no damage on a successful DEX save for half (sample text).

features.name: Sneak Attack 4d6
features.description: Sneak Attack damage increases.

features.name: Sneak Attack 5d6
features.description: Sneak Attack damage increases.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: A scholar of arcane magic (sample class data).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Cast arcane spells using Intelligence; prepare spells from your spellbook.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: On a short rest, recover expended spell slots (sample text).

features.name: Scholarly Pursuit
features.description: Gain expertise in one Intelligence skill (sample text).

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.description: Cast a chosen 1st- and 2nd-circle spell at will (sample text).

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: A divine champion who channels the power of a god (sample class data).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Cast divine spells using Wisdom.

features.name: Divine Order
features.description: Choose a role in your faith that grants a benefit (sample text).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Channel divine energy for a magical effect.

features.name: Sear Undead
features.description: Your turning harms undead (sample text).

subclasses.name: Weapon Master (sample)
subclasses.description: A sample fighter subclass. Replace with a real one in Settings.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a 19 or 20 (sample text).

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: Add half proficiency to STR, DEX and CON checks you're not proficient in (sample text).

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Critical hits on 18-20 (sample text).

features.name: Shadow Step
features.description: Bonus action: teleport between areas of dim light within 30 ft. (sample text).

features.name: Fade
features.description: Become invisible until the end of your turn after a Sneak Attack (sample text).

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: Protect allies from your evocation spells (sample text).

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: Creatures take half damage from your cantrips on a successful save (sample text).

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: Healing spells restore extra HP equal to 2 + spell circle (sample text).

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: When you heal others, you also heal (sample text).

talents.name: Combat Conditioning
talents.description: Your training makes you hardier in battle (sample text).

talents.name: Shield Training (sample)
talents.description: You are practiced at defending yourself and allies with a shield (sample text).

talents.name: Polearm Training (sample)
talents.description: You make the most of reach weapons (sample text).

talents.name: Arcane Dabbler (sample)
talents.description: You learn a cantrip and a 1st-circle spell from the Arcane list (sample text).

talents.name: Ritualist
talents.description: You can cast certain spells as rituals (sample text).

talents.name: Touch of Luck
talents.description: Fortune favors you; you can spend Luck more effectively (sample text).

talents.name: Aware
talents.description: You are hard to surprise and quick to act (sample text).

talents.name: Skillful (sample)
talents.description: Gain proficiency in additional skills or tools (sample text).

talents.name: Trade Skills
talents.description: You are expert in practical trades (sample text).
